name: next-steps-plus
description: Pick many. Tab once. Claude Code suggests your next prompts: tick several, press Tab, and get one numbered prompt. Built on next-steps.

selectMode.title: Selection mode (default: multi)
selectMode.description: single: a number key puts that one suggestion in the prompt box (as the original next-steps). multi: number keys toggle suggestions, 8 selects the ones marked (Recommended) (see Key 8 picks), and Tab or 9 puts all picked ones in the prompt box.

eightPicks.title: Key 8 picks (default: recommended)
eightPicks.description: In multi mode, what the 8 key picks. all: every suggestion except slash commands. recommended: the suggestions marked (Recommended). Pressing 8 again clears the picks.

maxSuggestions.title: Max suggestions (default: 5)
maxSuggestions.description: Show at most this many suggestions (1-7; in multi mode 8 picks all, 9 uses the picks, 0 dismisses). Option mode decides whether the list may be shorter.

optionMode.title: Option mode (default: up-to)
optionMode.description: How many options to list. up-to: only the next steps that clearly matter, from none up to Max suggestions, with no filler; you may see just one. exactly: always fill all Max suggestions slots, unless the conversation is clearly finished.

display.title: Display (default: label)
display.description: What each suggestion shows. label: a short label, as the original next-steps. label+prompt: the label, with its full prompt dimmed under it. prompt: the full prompt itself, so you see exactly what you pick; best with the standard or brief prompt style, since long prompts take many rows.

promptStyle.title: Prompt style (default: standard)
promptStyle.description: standard: no length guidance, as the original next-steps. detailed: 1-3 sentences with scope and what done looks like. brief: one short sentence.

combineHeader.title: Header for several picks (default: "Do these tasks:")
combineHeader.description: Line put above the numbered list when several suggestions are picked. Empty for none.

extraInstructions.title: Extra instructions (default: none)
extraInstructions.description: Your own preferences for the suggestions, e.g. 'write prompts in Thai' or 'always include a test step'.

ghostText.title: Tab ghost text (default: on)
ghostText.description: Also offer the top suggestion as dim ghost text in the prompt box, taken with Tab.

markRecommended.title: Mark recommended (default: on)
markRecommended.description: Put (Recommended) after each next step the model would advise taking now (there can be more than one), as Claude's own multiple-choice questions do. Tab ghost text offers the first of them; in multi mode, 8 can select them all.

suggestSkills.title: Suggest skills and slash commands (default: on)
suggestSkills.description: Tell the suggester which skills and slash commands this session has, so a suggestion can be one of them.

minAnswerChars.title: Shortest answer to suggest after (default: 80)
minAnswerChars.description: Skip suggestions after answers shorter than this many characters.
